question: Which sites had the worst SLA performance last quarter?
What is the average resolution time per priority over the last 6 months?
Which assets at BER-01 had the lowest uptime in the last 90 days?
Which sites had the worst SLA performance last quarter?
sql:
SELECT r.site_id, s.name, COUNT(*) AS requests,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN r.sla_met THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS sla_met_pct
FROM ops_demo.lakehouse.request_history r JOIN ops_demo.lakehouse.sites s USING (site_id)
WHERE r.closed_at >= date_trunc('QUARTER', add_months(current_date(), -3))
  AND r.closed_at < date_trunc('QUARTER', current_date())
GROUP BY r.site_id, s.name ORDER BY sla_met_pct ASC

content:
This space holds HISTORICAL operations data. Live/open service requests are not here; they live in the internal service desk system.
request_history: closed service requests (one row per request). SLA performance = share of rows with sla_met = true. resolution_hours = hours from opened_at to closed_at. Priorities P1 (most urgent) to P4.
asset_daily_metrics: one row per asset per day with uptime_pct and incident_count. Join to assets_dim on asset_id, and assets_dim to sites on site_id.
Always show site_id together with the site name. 'Last quarter' means the previous full calendar quarter.
